info.title: Permguard discovery
info.description: The well-known documents of the three-layer discovery chain and the stream listing.

get.summary: A plane's, or the process's, configuration document
get.description: Served on the control plane, on the data plane and on the telemetry listener, each with its own schema: ControlPlaneConfiguration, DataPlaneConfiguration and ServerConfiguration.

200.description: The document of the listener asked.

get.x-grpc-note: gRPC returns the document as a JSON string (`GetServerConfigurationResponse.document_json`), control plane only; the data plane and the telemetry listener have no gRPC counterpart.

get.summary: The evidence streams a plane declares, enabled or not

200.description: Every declared stream; a disabled stream is listed with `enabled: false`.

get.x-grpc-note: No gRPC method lists the declared streams; REST-only.

configuration.description: The address of that interface's own configuration document.

stage.description: The interface's stage (WP-7.4a); a retired one is not listed.

sunset.description: When a deprecated interface stops being served; present only then.

InterfaceLink.description: Where one interface publishes what it offers.
InterfaceLink.x-grpc-note: Sub-object of the discovery documents, which gRPC carries as JSON text (`GetServerConfigurationResponse.document_json`).

state.description: The lifecycle phase when the document was answered (WP-7.4a).

jwks_uri.description: Where this plane's signing keys are published.

zones_endpoint.description: Absolute URL of the zone collection.

streams_endpoint.description: Where this plane lists the streams it declares.

interfaces.description: Interfaces this plane serves, by interface id; absent when it serves none.

ControlPlaneConfiguration.description: The control plane's document, built by hand in `control_configuration_document` (permguard-control-plane service.rs).
ControlPlaneConfiguration.x-grpc-note: Carried as JSON text in `permguard.control.v1.GetServerConfigurationResponse.document_json`, not as structured fields.

state.description: The lifecycle phase when the document was answered (WP-7.4a).

jwks_uri.description: Where this plane's signing keys are published.

streams_endpoint.description: Where this plane lists the streams it declares.

interfaces.description: Interfaces this plane exposes, each pointing at its own configuration; absent when none.

languages.description: The runtimes this build carries, each with whether this deployment serves it and its conformance gate's result (TL-6); absent from a plane that evaluates nothing.

DataPlaneConfiguration.x-grpc-note: The data plane serves no gRPC discovery method; REST-only (permguard.data.v1.DataPlane has GetInfo and GetHealth only).

state.description: The lifecycle phase when the document was answered (WP-7.4a).

grpc_endpoint.description: For a plane serving only gRPC, its endpoint instead.

PlaneLink.description: Where one plane publishes its own document; at least one member is present.
PlaneLink.x-grpc-note: Sub-object of the process registry, REST-only on the telemetry listener.

host_id.description: The Host's id, UUID text in lowercase; absent while the Host has no identity (WP-7.4a).

state.description: The Host's lifecycle phase when the document was answered (WP-7.4a).

planes.description: Every plane the process hosts, by public name.

jwks_uri.description: The operations ring as a JWKS, when the deployment publishes keys.

assurance.description: The Host's assurance profile, enforced locally (WP-2.8).

peer_sessions.description: Whether the Host listener serves peer Host sessions, and why not (WP-2.3).

listeners.description: Every listener of the process, sorted by name, with its class and what it demands of its clients (WP-2.11).

ServerConfiguration.description: The process-level registry served on the telemetry listener.
ServerConfiguration.x-grpc-note: The process-level registry is served on the telemetry listener only; no gRPC counterpart.

role.description: Which way it flows through this process.

StreamView.x-grpc-note: REST-only: no gRPC method lists streams.

StreamsDocument.description: The body of `/v1/streams`, built with `json!` in `streams_route`.
StreamsDocument.x-grpc-note: REST-only: no gRPC method lists streams.

profile.description: The assurance profile in force; `production` when the configuration states none.

enforcement.description: Always `local`: the Host enforces its profile, it never attests it.

added_controls.description: Controls of a higher profile the deployment switched on, by their stable names.

relaxations.description: Relaxations the values in force amount to, each one the profile permits.

Assurance.description: The assurance block `{profile, enforcement: local, added_controls[], relaxations[]}` (7-architecture-security.md#assurance-profiles); `GET /host/v1/status` carries the same block.
Assurance.x-grpc-note: The process-level registry has no gRPC counterpart; the same block travels over gRPC as `permguard.host.v1.Assurance` inside `GetStatusResponse`.

served.description: Whether the Host listener's `PeerChannel` serves peer Host sessions.

reason.description: Why not (`no_listener`, `disabled`, `no_client_certificate`), or the limit sessions are served under (`tls_1_2_refused`); absent when there is nothing to say. A deployment behind a TLS-terminating proxy or sidecar states `admin.peer_sessions: disabled`.

PeerSessions.description: Whether peer Host sessions are served (WP-2.3): only on a mutual-TLS Host listener whose connections are end to end, on TLS 1.3; `GET /host/v1/status` carries the same block.
PeerSessions.x-grpc-note: The process-level registry has no gRPC counterpart; the same block travels over gRPC as `permguard.host.v1.PeerSessions` inside `GetStatusResponse`.

name.description: The surface: `host-api`, `telemetry`, or a Plane's `<plane>-<protocol>` (`control-http`, `data-grpc`, `control-http-grpc` for one listener serving both).

class.description: The listener class (WP-2.11): `host` (TLS, mTLS, Host proof for peers, Host grants for operators), `plane_public` (TLS or a declared upstream termination, deny by default) or `telemetry` (loopback or private bind, TLS outside that trust).

authentication.description: What the listener demands of a client before a route: `none` (the clear), `tls` (TLS the process serves), `mutual_tls` (a client certificate demanded) or `upstream_tls` (the clear behind an ingress or a sidecar the deployment declares terminates TLS: the relaxation `tls.terminated_upstream`).

client_allow.description: Whether an allow list names which authenticated clients it answers.

tls_min_version.description: The TLS minimum when the process serves TLS on it; absent otherwise.

Listener.description: One listener of the process and what it demands of its clients (WP-2.11): never its address, certificate or peers.
Listener.x-grpc-note: Part of the process-level registry, served on the telemetry listener only; `GET /host/v1/status` carries the same members as `HostListener`.

descriptor_digest.description: `sha256:` and the hex digest of the runtime's language descriptor.

experimental.description: Whether serving it takes an explicit opt-in.

served.description: Whether this deployment loads ledgers of this runtime: opted into when experimental, and its gate passing from `production` up.

LanguageListing.description: One runtime of a data plane's discovery document (TL-6).
LanguageListing.x-grpc-note: REST-only, as the data plane's document is.

production_ready.description: Whether every item of the languages model's conformance gate passes.

open.description: The items that do not pass, in the model's order.

ConformanceGate.x-grpc-note: REST-only, as the data plane's document is.

x-grpc-unmapped.note: `document_json` holds the JSON text of the document REST answers as the body
